description:
Goal: route every consumer that needs a typed def-head form to build_definition_form directly, instead of through a mode-gated surface read: apply_compiler_define (the Fz.Compiler.define payload), read_protocol_body_surface / read_protocol_impl_body_surface (callbacks), discover_modules typed and MacroCall+reread arms, and the bootstrap entry (is_bootstrap). The bootstrap stays the one origin whose def-heads reach the extractor directly with no macro bounce.

Why: structure emerges from the define pipeline, not from a CompilerFragment source read. After this, no consumer depends on CompilerFragment-mode reading to obtain typed forms.

Signal: all typed-form consumers call build_definition_form; the only remaining CompilerFragment reader use is the about-to-be-deleted build_form arm; full lib green, zero warnings; behavior-preserving. Depends on fz-s00.1. Blocks fz-s00.3.
title: Feed define tier, bootstrap, protocol, discovery from the typed extractor
